decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 and merely mentioned on the website, the cloud contact centre service is still an uncertain but cheap option in a growing market, so a large telecom firm with many options keeps it open until results show whether its value is real.

The call number routing platform has its own page, which signals early commitment, and it builds on the firm's core telephony infrastructure at low cost, so after one year there is no evidence that would justify abandoning it.
